title: Strict Inequality on Temperature Threshold for Fan Activation
expected: Fan turns ON when temperature is exactly 30.0 C
observed: Fan remains OFF when temperature is 30.0 C due to strict greater-than comparison
likely_cause: Line 44 uses `t > 30.0` instead of `t >= 30.0`, violating rule R1 which specifies fan is ON when temperature >= 30.0 C.

title: Missing Sensor Failure Handling and Fail-Safe Operation
expected: Print '[ERROR] SENSOR_FAIL' and turn the fan ON when sensor read fails (NaN)
observed: Prints temp=nan fan=OFF without any error message or fail-safe fan activation
likely_cause: The firmware lacks a check for `isnan(t)` to detect sensor read failures, completely missing the error logging and fail-safe logic required by R5.

title: Missing Hysteresis Logic for Fan Turn-Off
expected: Fan remains ON when temperature drops to 29.0 C after being ON, until it drops to <= 28.0 C
observed: Fan turns OFF immediately when temperature drops to 29.0 C because branch `else if (t < 30.0)` turns it off
likely_cause: The control logic uses `t < 30.0` instead of incorporating the 2 C hysteresis rule (turning off only when temperature <= 28.0 C once ON), and lacks state tracking for hysteresis.
